definitions.explanation: A building put together on site from parts made in a factory, quick and cheap to build and often temporary.

examples.japanese: プレハブ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{倉庫|そうこ}→倉庫：04044_souko⟧。
⟦{工事中|こうじちゅう}→工事中：09625_koujichuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧プレハブ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{事務所|じむしょ}→事務所：01032_jimusho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: During construction, we use a prefab office.

examples.japanese: ⟦{災害|さいがい}→災害：09636_saigai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧、⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{校庭|こうてい}→校庭：04147_koutei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧プレハブ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仮設住宅|かせつじゅうたく}→仮設住宅：33411_kasetsujuutaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{建|た}てられた→建てる：01189_tateru⟧。
examples.english: After the disaster, prefab temporary housing was put up in the school grounds.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
From English "prefab(ricated)."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- プレハブ{小屋|ごや}: a prefab hut or shed
- プレハブ⟦{校舎|こうしゃ}→校舎：02801_kousha⟧: prefab classrooms
- プレハブ⟦{住宅|じゅうたく}→住宅：03280_juutaku⟧: a prefab house

USAGE:
Suggests something quick, cheap and temporary; a well-built factory-made house is usually not called プレハブ in advertising.
